name: SF2 v-next.1 - Discovery Maps + Manual Import + Cache (F27+F29)

parameters.content: SF2 v-next - Discovery with two sources (F27). Places path = the original SF2 (profile-driven Apify Google Places). Manual-import path: reads an import Sheet with exact headers company_name, domain, location, source_url; a missing header halts the branch with a Gmail draft naming the header; rows are normalised (domain lowercased, www./scheme stripped, location trimmed) and emitted in the SAME candidate contract with source='manual_import' + source_url, merging into the same Collect return so SF4 dedupe handles both paths identically. Input adds discovery_source ('places' default | 'manual_import'), import_sheet_id, import_tab.

parameters.subject: SF2 import halted - missing header
parameters.message: ={{ "The manual-import branch halted before reading any company rows. Missing required header: " + $json.missing_header + ". Required headers (exact): company_name, domain, location, source_url. No discovery ran and nothing was spent." }}

parameters.jsCode:
const err = ($('Validate + Normalise Import').first().json || {}).import_error || 'unknown';
return [{ json: { success: false, count: 0, candidates: [], import_error: err } }];

const cands = $input.all().map(i => i.json);
return { json: { success: true, count: cands.length, candidates: cands } };

parameters.query: SELECT profile FROM search_profiles WHERE id = $1::uuid

SELECT c.result_company_ids AS candidates, c.discovered_count AS count, true AS hit
FROM discovery_cache c
WHERE c.cache_key = encode(sha256($1::bytea), 'hex') AND c.expires_at > now()
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL, NULL, false
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM discovery_cache c WHERE c.cache_key = encode(sha256($1::bytea), 'hex') AND c.expires_at > now())

INSERT INTO cost_ledger (run_id, workflow, provider, event_type, units, cost_usd, company_id, idempotency_key)
VALUES ($1, 'SF2 v-next.1', 'apify', 'cache_hit_zero', 0, 0, NULL, 'sf2:cachehit:' || $1 || ':' || $2)
ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING

parameters.jsCode:
const key = ($('Cache Key (F29)').first().json) || {};
return (key.pairs || []).map(x => ({ json: x }));

const p = $input.item.json || {};
return { json: {
  source: 'apify_maps',
  source_id: p.placeId || null,
  name: p.title || '',
  place_id: p.placeId || null,
  category: p.categoryName || null,
  location: p.city || p.address || null,
  website: p.website || null,
  phone: p.phone || null,
  rating: (p.totalScore === undefined ? null : p.totalScore),
  review_count: (p.reviewsCount === undefined ? null : p.reviewsCount),
  raw: p
} };

const cands = $input.all().map(i => i.json);
return { json: { success: true, count: cands.length, candidates: cands } };

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO discovery_cache (cache_key, query_norm, location_norm, radius_m, profile_hash, result_company_ids, discovered_count, expires_at)
VALUES (encode(sha256($1::bytea), 'hex'), $2, $3, $4, encode(sha256($5::bytea), 'hex'), $6::jsonb, $7, now() + ($8::text || ' hours')::interval)
ON CONFLICT (cache_key) DO UPDATE SET result_company_ids = EXCLUDED.result_company_ids, discovered_count = EXCLUDED.discovered_count, created_at = now(), expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at

parameters.jsCode:
const prep = ($('Prep Cache Store (F29)').first().json) || {};
return [{ json: { success: true, count: prep.count || 0, candidates: prep.candidates || [], cache_hit: false } }];
